summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market, evidenced by massive $14.7B SPX premium and a low 0.41 P/C ratio. Significant directional conviction is visible in the massive accumulation of SPX 7000C contracts expiring in late 2026, with single strikes like the 2026-09-18 expiry seeing over $1.4B in single-day buying. Persistent interest is confirmed by multi-day accumulation in SPX 7000C and 6000C strikes, totaling billions in premium over the last four sessions, alongside a massive $2.1B hedge in SPX 12000P for 2027. Traders should watch for continued upward momentum in SPX/SPY and NVDA/MSFT, but monitor for any reversal in the aggressive SPX 8000P long-dated put buying which suggests large-scale tail-risk hedging.
